---
title: "Profiles and cross-sections"
description: "Sample a modeled surface along a transect and assemble plot-ready hydrogeologic section data."
output: rmarkdown::html_vignette
---

`ps_surface_profile()` samples explicit line features at a documented count or
spacing and preserves unsupported values. `ps_cross_section()` adds land
surface, depth, support, uncertainty, projected wells, perpendicular offsets,
and absolute screen elevations. Wells beyond the offset rule are inventoried.
The result does not invent hydrostratigraphy and is not a three-dimensional
groundwater-flow model.

```{r, eval=FALSE}
profile <- ps_surface_profile(transect, surfaces, step=25)
section <- ps_cross_section(transect, head, dem, wells, maximum_well_offset=50)
```
